summary: A short, black-and-white Svelte page for Shantell Martin's open-source marker font: an empty 'Click anywhere' screen the visitor fills with words, a first-person story with free-download links, a six-slider 'Try Me!' sandbox, an axis glossary and an 830-cell character grid. Every surface is a rounded white or black card, like sheets of paper on a desk.

instances.variantDefinition: An almost empty first screen invites the visitor to click or tap anywhere; each click drops a word or phrase in the font at the pointer, with randomised style or axis values and a small entry animation, so the visitor composes the hero.
instances.look: A blank white screen (~80vh) with only 'CLICK ANYWHERE' in small bold bouncy caps at the centre and the fixed pill nav in the corners
instances.feel: Open, a blank sheet waiting for marks
instances.ux: Clicking (or tapping: the hint switches to 'TAP ANYWHERE' on touch) places one of Shantell Martin's 'May you…' phrases at the pointer, in varying weight, italic, informality and bounce, with a wobble animation; the hint disappears once the wall fills
instances.learn: Let the first interaction be a single click on empty space: the visitor makes the specimen, which suits a font born from an artist drawing on walls

reconstruction.layout: Full-width white field 1440×720 (80vh); hint centred at ~y=300; fixed nav pills top-left and top-right; the field is the click target (#wall)
reconstruction.typography: Hint ~32px ShantellSans wght 800, BNCE -100, INFM 0, uppercase, tracked ~0.1em; stamped phrases presumably at random sizes and axis values (wght 300–800, ital 0–1, INFM 0–100, BNCE -100–100)
reconstruction.behaviour: click/tap → append an absolutely positioned span at pointer coords with a random phrase and random axis values; CSS keyframes 'wobble' / 'wobbleBounce' animate BNCE; animations are paused via a --animationState custom property (respecting reduced motion or a pause toggle); separate mouse and touch hints
reconstruction.content: Shantell Martin's 'May you…' affirmations (credited in the footer: '"May you…" words by Shantell Martin')

instances.look: Black rounded card with the headline 'WORDS ARE MADE UP OF LINES' in big white marker caps, then two columns of white text: intro and an italic, rule-indented quote from Shantell Martin on the left, licence, credits and download links on the right
instances.feel: Personal and frank: a dyslexic artist explaining why she made a font
instances.ux: static text with inline links (Shantell Martin, ArrowType, Anya Danilova, OFL licence)
instances.learn: Let the artist's own story (spelling tests, dyslexia, Comic Sans) carry the 'why' in her voice, set off as an italic quote with a left rule

reconstruction.layout: Card inset ~8px from the viewport, radius ~16px, black, ~1140px tall; headline centred, two lines; two text columns ~580px wide from x≈120 and x≈750, 60px gutter; quote indented with a 1px grey left rule
reconstruction.typography: Headline ~100px ShantellSans wght ~800, BNCE -50, uppercase, centred, leading ~1.0; body ~20px/1.5 opsz 12, white; quote italic (ital 1); credits ~12px uppercase tracked; signature '— Shantell Martin' italic
reconstruction.content: Real copy: what the font is (marker-style, 5-axis variable + statics), Shantell Martin's first-person origin story, licence (SIL OFL 1.1), script coverage (Latin, Cyrillic), credits (ArrowType, Anya Danilova, Google Fonts)

instances.look: At the foot of the story card's right column: a white pill 'DOWNLOAD LATEST RELEASE ↓' and two underlined links 'SEE THE PROJECT ON GITHUB ↗' and 'GET IT ON GOOGLE FONTS ↗', under a plain-language OFL paragraph
instances.ux: Pill downloads the release zip from GitHub directly; links open GitHub and Google Fonts; the fixed nav 'Download' button opens a dropdown with the same three links
instances.learn: For an open-source font, put the licence in one friendly sentence ('use it in almost any way you can imagine!') right above the download button

reconstruction.layout: Stack in the right column: pill ~300×28px with 2px radius-full white fill, then two text links ~24px apart, each with a thin underline
reconstruction.typography: ~12px ShantellSans uppercase, tracked ~0.08em; pill text black on white, links white
reconstruction.content: Download latest release ↓ / See the project on GitHub ↗ / Get it on Google Fonts ↗

instances.look: A white rounded card with 'Try Me!' huge and centred, and below a hairline-ruled panel of six thin slider rows (Font Size 146, Weight 700, Italic 0, Informality 0, Bounce 0, Spacing 0), each a label, a number and a black dot on a long line
instances.ux: Type directly into the headline (blinking custom cursor); drag any dot or type a number to set size 4–288, wght 300–800, ital 0–1, INFM 0–100, BNCE -100–100, SPAC 0–100; changes apply live
instances.learn: Give every axis the same minimal row (label, number field, dot on a hairline): six controls read as one calm panel under one big word

reconstruction.layout: Card full width minus ~8px, radius ~16px, ~770px tall; editable sample centred in the top ~540px; control panel bottom ~210px with a hairline top border, 6 rows ~30px each: label column ~120px, number field ~40px, slider track spanning the rest

reconstruction.behaviour: input[type=range] and paired input[type=number] write CSS custom properties (--size, --wght, --ital, --infm, --bnce, --spac) on #type-area, which drive font-variation-settings and letter-spacing; text alignment centred; custom blinking cursor span

instances.look: 'VARIABLE AXES' heading top-left and a 2-column grid of five axis cards, each showing 'HHH → HHH' (min → max), the axis name in caps, its range in brackets, a grey code-style tag (wght, ital, INFM, BNCE, SPAC) and a short paragraph
instances.ux: static (animation hooks exist but are paused)
instances.learn: Use the same three letters 'HHH' at both ends of each axis so the only thing that changes is the axis itself; add the 4-letter tag for developers

reconstruction.content: Real explanations per axis, e.g. 'You know it and love it, and now it's variable!'
